entities.name: Vela
entities.description: Legendary human wizard from an unknown plane, symbol of the night's allure and peril and harbinger of dusk.

entities.name: Krond
entities.description: Figure whose opposition binds Vela's existence, the counterpart of light to her darkness.

relations.note: Her existence is bound in opposition to Krond.
